nodes.label: Astrology as a Symbolic Language
nodes.rationale: Astrology is presented as a symbolic language that reads patterns, tendencies, and timing of life, not mechanical event prediction.

nodes.label: Astrology Elements (Fire, Earth, Air, Water)
nodes.rationale: The four elements are the fundamental energy types in Western astrology describing how a person channels life force.

nodes.label: Modality (Cardinal, Fixed, Mutable)
nodes.rationale: Modality describes the movement pattern of energy — how energy initiates, sustains, or adapts.

nodes.label: Birth Chart (Natal Chart)
nodes.rationale: The birth chart is a map of the sky at the moment of birth, used as a foundational tool for personality and life pattern analysis.

nodes.label: Weighted Elements Scoring System
nodes.rationale: Sun/Moon/Asc get 3 pts, inner planets 2 pts, outer planets 1 pt, MC 1 pt — designed to reflect the differential influence of chart points.

nodes.label: Zodiac Polarity (Positive/Negative)
nodes.rationale: Polarity describes whether a sign's energy turns outward (positive/active) or inward (negative/receptive).

nodes.label: Sign Rulership
nodes.rationale: Each zodiac sign is ruled by a planet, giving the sign its tonal character. The system is traced to Ptolemy's Tetrabiblos.

nodes.label: Ptolemaic Rulership System
nodes.rationale: Ptolemy's Tetrabiblos describes the symmetrical arrangement of planetary rulers starting from the Moon (Cancer) and Sun (Leo) as luminaries.

nodes.label: Tropical Zodiac
nodes.rationale: The tropical zodiac is fixed to the equinoxes and solstices, not the actual constellations, making it a seasonal system.

nodes.label: Domicile (Planetary Home)
nodes.rationale: A planet in its own ruling sign is in domicile — at home. Its energy expresses naturally and strongly.

nodes.label: Detriment
nodes.rationale: A planet in the sign opposite its domicile is in detriment — it works in an unfamiliar environment.

nodes.label: Exaltation
nodes.rationale: Exaltation is a sign where a planet is honored and its dignity elevated, though it is not the planet's own home.

nodes.label: Fall
nodes.rationale: Fall is the sign opposite exaltation; the planet's energy is not elevated and may express with difficulty.

nodes.label: Essential Dignity
nodes.rationale: Essential dignity encompasses domicile, detriment, exaltation, and fall as measures of a planet's intrinsic strength by sign position.

nodes.label: Angular Houses (1, 4, 7, 10)
nodes.rationale: Angular houses are the most powerful houses because they sit on the chart's main axes (ASC, IC, DSC, MC); planets here take center stage.

nodes.label: Ascendant (ASC)
nodes.rationale: The Ascendant is the rising sign on the eastern horizon; it represents the self, the mask, and how one engages the world.

nodes.label: Midheaven (MC)
nodes.rationale: The MC is the highest point in the chart, representing career, public image, status, and life direction.

nodes.label: Quadrant I: Independent + Private (Houses 1-3)
nodes.rationale: Self-definition quadrant: life develops through self, independence, and personal initiative in the private sphere.

nodes.label: Quadrant II: Dependent + Private (Houses 4-6)
nodes.rationale: Private relationships quadrant: growth through family, close bonds, home, daily work, and caring for intimates.

nodes.label: Quadrant III: Dependent + Public (Houses 7-9)
nodes.rationale: Social definition quadrant: growth through relationships, partnership, shared resources, and expanded worldview.

nodes.label: Quadrant IV: Independent + Public (Houses 10-12)
nodes.rationale: Public purpose quadrant: life driven by career, public role, networks, and legacy — self-initiated in the public sphere.

nodes.label: Collective Souls (Pluto Generation Theory)
nodes.rationale: Each generation born under the same Pluto sign shares a collective mission or soul purpose tied to the transformative themes of that sign.

nodes.label: Sect (Day/Night Chart)
nodes.rationale: Sect divides charts into day (Sun above horizon) and night (Sun below). Planets in their own sect express more naturally; malefics are less harmful.

nodes.label: Diurnal Sect (Day Chart)
nodes.rationale: Day chart sect: Sun, Jupiter, Saturn are sect mates. Life tends toward clarity, structure, public expression, and goal-orientation.

nodes.label: Nocturnal Sect (Night Chart)
nodes.rationale: Night chart sect: Moon, Venus, Mars are sect mates. Life tends toward emotion, relationship, interiority, and receptive sensitivity.

nodes.label: Dispositor
nodes.rationale: A dispositor is the planetary ruler of the sign another planet occupies. Tracing the chain reveals the power structure of the chart.

nodes.label: Final Dispositor
nodes.rationale: A final dispositor is a planet in its own domicile that ends the dispositor chain; represents the ultimate manager of the chart.

nodes.label: Mutual Reception
nodes.rationale: Two planets in each other's domicile create a closed loop of mutual support in the dispositor chain.

nodes.label: Grand Trine
nodes.rationale: Houses of the same element form a trine cycle. When one house is weak, the other two can support it — creating a self-sustaining energy system.

nodes.label: Malefics (Saturn and Mars)
nodes.rationale: In traditional astrology, Saturn and Mars are malefics — they bring difficulty, testing, friction. Their effect is moderated by sect.

nodes.label: Benefics (Jupiter and Venus)
nodes.rationale: Jupiter and Venus are benefic planets that bring growth, opportunity, harmony, and support.

nodes.label: Chart Ruler
nodes.rationale: The chart ruler is the planetary ruler of the Ascendant sign, considered the key to the whole chart.

nodes.label: Gen X Pluto Generation
nodes.rationale: Gen X spans Pluto in Virgo and Libra. Collective mission: fix systems then rebalance relationships toward justice.

nodes.label: Millennial Pluto Generation
nodes.rationale: Millennials span Pluto in Libra, Scorpio, Sagittarius. Collective mission: seek depth, truth, and expanded meaning.

nodes.label: Gen Z Pluto Generation
nodes.rationale: Gen Z spans Pluto in Sagittarius and Capricorn. Collective mission: question beliefs and confront societal structures.

nodes.label: Gen Alpha Pluto Generation
nodes.rationale: Gen Alpha: primarily Pluto in Capricorn. Collective mission: grow up in a world where old structures are crumbling.

nodes.label: Gen Beta Pluto Generation
nodes.rationale: Gen Beta: Pluto in Aquarius. Collective mission: redesign society, technology, and collective living from the ground up.

nodes.label: Elemental House Trine Cycles
nodes.rationale: Houses sharing the same element form trine cycles: Fire (1-5-9), Earth (2-6-10), Air (3-7-11), Water (4-8-12). Each cycle self-regulates.

Essential Dignity: Domicile, Detriment, Exaltation, Fall
Three House Groups: Angular, Succedent, Cadent
